description: Diatonic chord generator: six transposers each shift the input pitch by a number of scale degrees and octaves, and the enabled ones come out together as one polyphonic chord

params.text: Transposes that row by this many scale degrees above the input, 0 to +11; a third is +2 and a fifth is +4
Shifts that row by whole octaves, -2 to +2, on top of its scale-degree setting
Turns that row on and off, lighting while it is on; each enabled row adds one channel to the V/Oct output
Sets the root of the scale that the quantizing and the transposing are done in
Sets the scale that the quantizing and the transposing are done in, the seven diatonic modes and a further six scales

inputs.text: Adds to the transposition of every enabled row, a twelfth of a volt per scale degree; a polyphonic cable feeds each enabled row its own channel, in panel order from the top
Sets the scale root from a voltage, a twelfth of a volt per semitone, wrapping within the octave
Sets the scale from a voltage, a twelfth of a volt per scale, wrapping through the list; Mode CV only diatonic cuts that list to the seven modes
The pitch every enabled row transposes, read from channel 0 at 1V per octave and quantized to the scale
Sets the scale root and mode from a twelve-channel Poly External Scale cable: under 4V a note outside the scale, under 9V a note in it, above that the root

outputs.text: The chord at 1V per octave, one channel per enabled row, in panel order from the top
The current scale as a twelve-channel Poly External Scale cable: 0V for a note outside it, 8V for a note in it and 10V for the root

notes: nothing comes out until one of the six rows is enabled with its button; with none enabled the V/Oct output carries no channels
the scale can be set from the panel pickers, from the Key and Mode inputs or from the PES input, and whichever changed most recently is the one in force
with a cable in XP, the number printed beside an enabled row is the total transposition that row is applying, in scale degrees
the red lamp beside the PES input lights when that cable has fewer than twelve channels or carries a scale the module does not recognise
menu: Mode CV only diatonic — cuts the Mode input's list to the seven diatonic modes; the panel's own mode picker offers every scale either way
Sharps&Flats: Default+sharps, Default+flats, Sharps, Flats — chooses how a note that could be written either way is named

inputs.1: 1V per octave · stepped · one channel only
inputs.3: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
